Overview

Ushuaia is a city in Tierra del Fuego with a population of 82,615. The world’s southernmost city in Tierra del Fuego, with stunning mountains, glaciers, and penguin colonies. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
